title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: To determine if a set of columns is linearly independent, consider if any column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others. Think about the relationships between height in inches and centimeters, and weight in pounds and kilograms.

title: Conversion Relationships
text: Remember that height in inches is calculated from height in centimeters using the formula: height (in) $$=$$ height (cm) / $$2.54$$. Similarly, weight in pounds is calculated from weight in kilograms using: weight (lb) $$=$$ weight (kg) * $$2.2$$.

title: Checking Linear Independence
text: Can height (in) be expressed as a linear combination of height (cm)?

title: Checking Linear Independence for Weight
text: Can weight (lb) be expressed as a linear combination of weight (kg)?

title: Span of the Columns
text: The span of a set of vectors is the set of all possible linear combinations of those vectors. Consider how the conversion formulas affect the span of the columns.
